name: Tarang
college: Lady Shri Ram College for Women
desc: LSR's annual cultural festival, which traditionally opens the Delhi University fest season. Known for its wide range of competitions and a food festival that draws visitors from across the NCR.

name: Reverie
desc: A three-day festival that has in some years kicked off the fest season ahead of LSR, combining theatre, magic shows, dance, stand-up comedy and inter-college competitions.

name: Mecca
desc: One of Delhi University's oldest cultural festivals, featuring music, dance recitals, fashion shows and large star nights.

name: Tempest
desc: Miranda House's annual festival, distinguished by its focus on women's empowerment and self-expression alongside music, culture and theatre.

name: Nexus
desc: Among the best-organised festivals in South Campus, known for its one-act theatre and band competitions.

name: Confluence
desc: Popular primarily as a music festival spanning many genres, with performances by well-known artists and DJs.

name: Crossroads
desc: One of the largest festivals in Delhi University, backed by major corporate sponsorship and known for its large-scale pro-nites.

name: Mosaic
desc: A three-day annual festival with a wide spread of inter-college competitions, known for its fashion show, musicals and street play events.

name: Renaissance
desc: Kirori Mal College's annual festival, which draws large crowds each year.

name: Shruti
desc: The annual cultural festival of IP College for Women, one of the oldest women's colleges in the University.

name: Manjari
desc: Daulat Ram College's annual cultural festival, featuring inter-college societies competitions.

name: Lashkara
desc: SGTB Khalsa College's annual festival, known for its bhangra and Punjabi cultural events.

name: Montage
desc: The annual cultural festival of Jesus and Mary College in South Campus.

name: Ullas
desc: Kamala Nehru College's annual cultural festival.

name: Kalrav
desc: A more recent addition to the Delhi University fest circuit.

name: Tide
desc: A more recent addition to the Delhi University fest circuit.
